## Getting Help

### 1. Check the Documentation First

Most questions are answered in the README and samples:
- [README](../README.md) — Quick start, install, API overview
- [samples/](../samples) — Sample apps and implementation patterns

### 3. Discord Community

Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/UbNDDBTNqb) for real-time help from the community and maintainers.

### 4. GitHub Issues

For bugs and feature requests, [open a GitHub Issue](https://github.com/sceneview/sceneview/issues/new).

**Bug reports should include:**
- SceneView version
- Platform (Android, iOS, Web, etc.)
- Device model and OS version
- Minimal reproduction code
- Stack trace (if crash)

### 5. Sample Apps

Sample apps are included in the repository under `samples/`. They cover every feature and are the best way to learn SceneView patterns.

## Security

For security vulnerabilities, please see our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).
